title: Inner-shell ionization form factors F(s, E0) for STEM-EDX: 525 channels (K, L1-L3, M1-M5) computed with Temari
summary: Off-diagonal inner-shell ionization form factors F(s, E0) for quantitative STEM-EDX and ALCHEMI, computed from first principles for isolated atoms: the mixed dynamic form factor contracted over the ejected electron's energy and direction, for two Bloch waves separated by K = 4*pi*s*a0, then normalized at K = 0. 525 channels (K, L1-L3, M1-M5), 14,796 rows, on a momentum grid extending to s = 16 A^-1 (321 nodes). Generated by Temari (https://github.com/seto77/Temari) with the prescription DHFS-KS23-DiracB-KDIRAC2C-jsplit-fullrange-sym-v4-DSCF-FNUSX: kappa-resolved Dirac continuum states in a…
